Summarized translation of a mimeographed letter 
addressed to Mr. Chi Tah, Principal of the si 
Kuo Middle School For Girls, dated September 1 
Mr. Chi Tah, 

Rumours have been current to the effect 
that local schools intend to register with the "bogus" 
organizations. It is evident that your school is one 
of their number. Investigations have been made by 
our members who have secured strong evidence against 
you. We are indeed full of regret upon learning of 
your ridiculous activities. For the sake of the good 
fame which your school has enjoyed in the past, we 
are reluctant to deal with you in the manner accorded 
to traitors, as such action will greatly affect your 
school in the future. Apart from reporting to the 
Ministry of Education for necessary action, and 
writing to the Board of Directors of your institute, 
we hereby advise you to discern between right and 
wrong. Please retire at once from your present post. 


This is to serve as a severe warning. 


(Chopped) Shanghai Youth Anti--Japanese 
National Salvation League. 


Summarized translation of a mimeographed letter 
addressed to the Board of Directors of the Ai 
Kuo Middle School For Girls, dated September 1 
To Board of Directors, 

It is strongly rumoured that a number of 
local schools intend to register with the "bogus" 
organizations. People in various circles are paying 
great attention to this matter, 

For a long time, the "puppets" endeavoured 
to effect a control of schools in this “isolated island, ® 
and certain unscrupulous elements are reported to have 
made secret arrangements with the “puppets” for the 
registration of their institutions. Discreet enquiries 
made by this League have ascertained that a few schools 
actually intend to apply for registration and evidence 
has been secured that the Ai Kuo Middle School For Girls 
is among then. It engages traitorous teachers and 
violates the principle of the Ministry of Education by 
including a Japanese course in the foreign language 
curriculum. 

This fact makes us unable to keep silent. 
Therefore, apart from reporting the matter to the Ministry 
and warning the school direct, we request you to uphold 
justice, prevent the school authorities from such illegal 
activities and re-organize it in order to avoid the 
school being utilized by traitors to the detriment of 
the institute which has already had a good record for 


ten years. 


(Chopped) Shanghai Youth Anti-Japanese 
National Salvation League. 


Summarized translation of a mimeograPhed handbill 
addressed to teachers and students of the Ai Kuo 
Middle School For Girls and received by Mr. Chi Tah 
Dear teachers and schoolmates, 

The “enemy” is killing our brethren 
with utmost cruelty. They deprive us of our territory 
and massacre our brethren. They further attempt to 
take over the schools in the war affected areas, and 
force our educational institutions to register with 
them so that they can attain their end which is to 
enslave Chinese. 

Let us consider, if those schools are 
registered or taken over by the “enemy,” can we still 
read the “Book of Three Principles" or study the 
history relating to the war of resistance, or continue 
to do our national salvation work among them. We shall 
be compelled to study Japanese, and our mouths will be 
mizzied. But we are Chinese, and we cannot tolerate 
such treatment. 

We should not overlook the consequence 
of registration and the taking over of our institutions. 
Such attempt on the part of the enemy is worse than the 
bombing of our brethren and seizure of our territory by 
means of force. Therefore, it is incumbent upon every 
one of us to unite together for the support of our 
school. It is national salvation work. The Board of 
Directors has announced that the school will never be 
registered, but the announcement is contrary to the 
facts. The illegal activities on the part of our 
school authorities will not only be detrimental to 
the Ai Kuo Middle School but also will affect our 
TACe. It is evident that traitor Chi Tah is responsible 


for such activities, and therefore how can we recognize

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. M180.377/38.

REPORT
 BubblingWell REGISTRY
 Station,
 No. S. B. D.
 Date 15th. September 38.

Subject further to Attached Report S.B./D.8732.

Made by D.S. Ware. Forwarded by O. A. Perkins C.I.

D.C. Commr Sir,
Information
16/9

With reference to the attached memorandum by the D.C.
(Sp.Br.), Mr. Chi Fah ( 季 達 ) was interviewed by D.S.I. Wu
Chen Mo and the undersigned during the afternoon of 15/9/38,
and requested to report to Bubbling Well Station any similar
communications he might receive in the future.

Mr. Chi Fah agreed to do so, and said that in the
present instance he had not considered the affair serious
enough to merit police attention.

Also, it was learned that about the beginning of July
1938 an anonymous article inserted in the Lih Pao ( 力 報 )
and other mosquito newspapers, covertly referred to an old
established girls' school which was seeking registration with
the local Reformed Government. The Board of Directors
of the school replied to this attack during August through
an advertisement in several local newspapers. It was felt
by the board that other less favoured girls' schools had
instigated the rumour to entice students away from the Ai Kuo
Female School.

D.C. (S.B.)
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 16 SEP 1938 CRIME BRANCH）

Mr. Chi Fah deduces that the Shanghai Youth Anti-
Japanese National Salvation League was misinformed of the
school faculty's policy through the anonymous advertisement
already referred to, and then sent him the anonymous letters
dated 1/9/38.

（批：HR）

Craloobnath
Sen.Det.1/c.

（批：a.i. / SAR / 17/9 / C.G. / 17/9 / 17/9）

（签名）
D. S.
D. S.I. Wu Chen Mo.

报告
静安寺路捕房
分站，
编号 S. B. D.
日期 1938年9月15日。

事由：关于附件报告 S.B./D.8732 的后续事宜。

由警佐 Ware 呈报。经刑事侦缉督察 O. A. Perkins 转呈。

副总监先生，
情报
9月16日

关于特别分部副总监所附备忘录，季达（Chi Fah）先生于1938年9月15日下午接受了警督吴振模（Wu Chen Mo）及具名人的问询，并被要求若日后收到类似信件，须向静安寺路捕房报告。

季达先生表示同意，并称在此次事件中，他认为事态尚不严重，无需警方关注。

此外，获悉在1938年7月初，《力报》（Lih Pao）及其他小报刊登了一篇匿名文章，隐晦地提及一所历史悠久、正向当地维新政府申请注册的女子学校。该校董事会于8月通过在当地多家报纸刊登广告的方式回应了此次攻击。董事会认为，是其他处境较差的女子学校煽动了这一谣言，意图从爱国女中（Ai Kuo Female School）诱走学生。

特别分部副总监
（印章：副总监 1938年9月16日 刑事分部）

季达先生推断，“上海青年抗日救亡大同盟”因前述匿名广告而对学校教职员工的政策产生误解，随后向他寄送了日期为1938年9月1日的匿名信件。

（批注：HR）

Craloobnath
高级侦探长。

（批注：a.i. / SAR / 9月17日 / C.G. / 9月17日 / 9月17日）

（签名）
D. S.
警督 吴振模。

事由：《字林西报》（Standard）刊登题为“回复上海青年抗日救亡大同盟来信”的文章

由办事员罗伟康（Loh Wei-kong）呈报。经 C. **〔此处转录不清〕** 转呈。

关于附件中于9月10日刊登在《字林西报》上、题为“回复上海青年抗日救亡大同盟（上海青年抗日救亡大同盟）来信”的文章，该文由位于南阳路215号（静安寺区）的爱国女子中学校长季达（Chi Tah）先生所作，经查询，获得如下信息：

9月7日，季达先生收到一封邮递信件，声称发自“上海青年抗日救亡大同盟”，指控他已将其所属机构向“伪”组织注册。信中附有一张致董事会的便条，劝告他们主持正义并重组学校。两封信件均注明日期为9月1日，且为油印件。

9月9日，校长通过邮局收到一份油印传单，声称发自“爱国女中护校团（愛國女中護校團）”，收件人为该机构的教职员工和学生。传单谴责校长为汉奸，并敦促教职员工和学生将其驱逐出校。

致爱国女子中学校长季达先生的油印信摘要译文，日期为9月1日

季达先生：

近期有谣言流传，称本地学校打算向“伪”组织注册。显然，贵校也在其列。我方成员已进行调查，并掌握了针对你的有力证据。得知你荒谬的行径，我们深感遗憾。鉴于贵校过去享有的良好声誉，我们不愿以对待汉奸的方式处置你，因为此举将严重影响贵校的未来。除向教育部报告以采取必要行动，并致函贵校董事会外，特此劝告你明辨是非。请立即辞去现职。
此乃严厉警告。

（盖章）上海青年抗日救亡大同盟。

violates the principle of the Ministry of Education by
including a Japanese course in the foreign language
curriculum.

This fact makes us unable to keep silent.
Therefore, apart from reporting the matter to the Ministry
and warning the school direct, we request you to uphold
justice, prevent the school authorities from such illegal
activities and re-organize it in order to avoid the
school being utilized by traitors to the detriment of
the institute which has already had a good record for
ten years.

(Chopped) Shanghai Youth Anti-Japanese
National Salvation League.
pages.zh:
致爱国女子中学董事会的油印信摘要译文，日期为9月1日

致董事会：

有强烈谣言称，本地多所学校打算向“伪”组织注册。各界人士对此事高度关注。

长期以来，“傀儡”势力企图控制这“孤岛”上的学校，据悉某些不法分子已与“傀儡”秘密安排其机构注册事宜。经本同盟谨慎调查，证实确有少数学校打算申请注册，并有证据表明爱国女子中学位列其中。该校聘用汉奸教师，并在外语课程中加入日语课程，违反了教育部的原则。

这一事实使我们无法保持沉默。因此，除向教育部报告此事并直接警告学校外，我们请求你们主持正义，阻止校方进行此类非法活动，并重组学校，以避免这所已有十年良好记录的学校被汉奸利用，从而损害学校利益。

（盖章）上海青年抗日救亡大同盟。

pages.en:
Summarized translation of a mimeographed handbill
addressed to teachers and students of the Ai Kuo
Middle School For Girls and received by Mr. Chi Tah

Dear teachers and schoolmates,

The "enemy" is killing our brethren
with utmost cruelty. They deprive us of our territory
and massacre our brethren. They further attempt to
take over the schools in the war affected areas, and
force our educational institutions to register with
them so that they can attain their end which is to
enslave Chinese.

Let us consider, if those schools are
registered or taken over by the "enemy," can we still
read the "Book of Three Principles" or study the
history relating to the war of resistance, or continue
to do our national salvation work among them. We shall
be compelled to study Japanese, and our mouths will be
muzzled. But we are Chinese, and we cannot tolerate
such treatment.

We should not overlook the consequence
of registration and the taking over of our institutions.
Such attempt on the part of the enemy is worse than the
bombing of our brethren and seizure of our territory by
means of force. Therefore, it is incumbent upon every
one of us to unite together for the support of our
school. It is national salvation work. The Board of
Directors has announced that the school will never be
registered, but the announcement is contrary to the
facts. The illegal activities on the part of our
school authorities will not only be detrimental to
the Ai Kuo Middle School but also will affect our
race. It is evident that traitor Chi Tah is responsible
for such activities, and therefore how can we recognize
pages.zh:
致爱国女子中学师生、由季达先生收到的油印传单摘要译文

亲爱的老师和同学们：

“敌人”正极其残忍地杀害我们的同胞。他们剥夺我们的领土，屠杀我们的同胞。他们还试图接管受战争影响地区的学校，强迫我们的教育机构向其注册，以实现其奴役中国人的目的。

让我们思考一下，如果这些学校被“敌人”注册或接管，我们还能阅读《三民主义》，学习抗战历史，或在其中继续开展救国工作吗？我们将被迫学习日语，我们的嘴巴将被堵住。但我们是中国人，我们不能容忍这种待遇。

我们不应忽视注册和接管我们机构的后果。敌人的这种企图比轰炸我们的同胞和武力夺取我们的领土更恶劣。因此，我们每个人都有责任团结起来支持我们的学校。这是救国工作。董事会已宣布学校绝不会注册，但这一声明与事实不符。我校当局的非法活动不仅会损害爱国女中，还会影响我们的民族。显然，汉奸季达应对此类活动负责，因此我们怎能承认

pages.en:

him as the principal. The step we should take is
to expel him. Let us carry out the following :-
(1) We prefer the closure of the school rather
than registration with the "bogus" organizations.
(2) Oppose the inclusion of Japanese in the foreign
language curriculum.
(3) Expel immediately unscrupulous Chi Tah who is
hand in glove with the Japanese and who is
selling the privileges of the Chinese.
(4) Let us carry on the struggle until our aim is

(Chopped) Group to Support the Ai Kuo

他为校长。我们应该采取的步骤是将其驱逐。让我们执行以下事项：
(1) 我们宁愿学校关闭，也不愿向“伪”组织注册。
(2) 反对在外语课程中加入日语。
(3) 立即驱逐与日本人勾结、出卖中国人特权的不法分子季达。
(4) 让我们坚持斗争，直到实现我们的目标。

（盖章）爱国女中护校团。

pages.en:
A REPLY TO LETTER FROM THE SHANGHAI YOUTH ANTI-
JAPANESE NATIONAL SALVATION LEAGUE

The following advertisement appears in the
"Standard" of September 10 :-
To the Shanghai Youth Anti-Japanese National Salvation
League (上海青年抗日救國大同盟),
I am surprised at the contents of your letter.
Prior to the summer vacation this year, it was alleged
that our school had "registered." This was strongly
refuted by the Board of Directors of our school, while I
myself also declared that I would abide by the decision
of the Board of Directors.
In order to pay particular attention to Chinese
literature and to resume the literary class, our school
adopted the curriculum of ten years ago, but through an
oversight the Japanese class was included. This might
have given rise to misunderstanding. The mistake was
subsequently rectified and our school has decided not to
resume the literary class. Now the ordinary class, the
commercial class and the middle classes have resumed
studies and whether or not there is a class for Japanese
can be verified from our curriculum. Moreover, all the
teachers of our school are upright men.
As members of your League are intelligent
people, they can conduct further investigations about our
school. I am willing to undergo the severest penalty
that may be imposed by the country if I am found to have
betrayed my honour, because a mere resignation would not
be a sufficient penalty for such an offence. Not knowing
the address of your League, I publish this advertisement
in reply to your letter, hoping that it may serve to clear
up the misunderstanding.
Chi Tah (支達),
Principal of the Ai Kuo Middle School
for Girls.
pages.zh:
回复上海青年抗日救亡大同盟来信

以下广告刊登于9月10日的《字林西报》：
致上海青年抗日救亡大同盟（上海青年抗日救國大同盟），
我对你们来信的内容感到惊讶。在今年暑假之前，有人指控我校已“注册”。我校董事会对此进行了强烈驳斥，我自己也声明我将遵守董事会的决定。
为了特别重视国文并恢复文学班，我校采用了十年前的课程，但因疏忽而包含了日语班。这可能引起了误解。随后纠正了这一错误，我校已决定不再恢复文学班。现在，普通班、商业班和中学班已复课，是否有日语班可从我们的课程表中核实。此外，我校所有教师均为正直之人。
鉴于贵同盟成员皆为明智之士，你们可以对我校进行进一步调查。如果我被发现背叛了我的荣誉，我愿意接受国家可能施加的最严厉惩罚，因为仅仅辞职不足以惩罚此类罪行。由于不知贵同盟的地址，我刊登此广告以回复你们的来信，希望能以此消除误解。
支达（Chi Tah），
爱国女子中学校长。
